At QuantaSec, our CCTV surveillance solutions are engineered for precision and reliability. We offer comprehensive services including the design, installation, and ongoing maintenance of high-definition IP and hybrid CCTV systems. Every solution we deploy is fully compliant with SIRA and local UAE regulations.
Our systems go beyond traditional monitoring. With integrated video analytics, automatic number plate recognition (ANPR), facial recognition, and centralized monitoring, you get intelligent, real-time insights for enhanced protection of your property, people, and assets.
Whether securing a private residence, commercial building, or industrial complex, our CCTV services are tailored to meet your specific security goals. From selecting optimal camera placements to ensuring seamless remote access, we provide a fully managed surveillance experience.
Smart surveillance powered by advanced AI technologies.
